gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the current workflow transition rule configurations for my project to ensure they align with our process requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all workflow transition rule configurations, including details such as rule ID, transition ID, and associated conditions.

gold.user: As a workflow administrator, I need to update the existing workflow transition rule configurations to reflect the new approval process we have implemented.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated configuration details and return a success message along with the updated configuration data.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to delete obsolete workflow transition rule configurations that are no longer needed to keep our system clean and efficient.
gold.ideal: The API should process the deletion request and return a confirmation message indicating that the specified rule configurations have been successfully deleted.
